parsed.critic: C01 and C04 carry fly ash, so their high predictions may partly reflect nearest-example similarity rather than a validated fly-ash effect, and batch-to-batch variation plus high tree disagreement mean realized strength could undershoot estimates.
parsed.selection_rationale: These five span the low water-to-binder, high-cement-plus-slag pattern seen in mix-370 and mix-349 while hedging with the lowest-disagreement option C04 and a fly-ash variant C01, so the batch budget tests both the main hypothesis and its fly-ash sensitivity.
